company.name: Coordinatez
company.description: Coordinatez is an IT services and AI solutions company headquartered in Chicago, with its own development center in Mehsana, India. We design, build, and run web platforms, mobile apps, custom software, AI integrations, automation, and data systems for startups, SMEs, and enterprises.

services.name: AI Agents Development
services.description: Autonomous and semi-autonomous agents that execute multi-step business workflows — researching, deciding, and acting under defined guardrails.

services.name: AI Chatbot Development
services.description: Customer-facing and internal assistants grounded in your real content — answering accurately, escalating gracefully, and available 24/7.

services.name: AI Integration Services
services.description: Practical integration of large language models and AI services into the products and internal tools you already run.

services.name: API Development
services.description: Well-documented REST and GraphQL APIs that let your systems, partners, and products talk to each other safely.

services.name: Business Automation
services.description: Connecting the systems you already use and removing the copy-paste work between them — reliably, with error handling and visibility.

services.name: Cloud Solutions
services.description: Cloud architecture, migration, and DevOps — infrastructure that scales with demand and doesn't page you at 3 a.m.

services.name: Custom Software Development
services.description: Purpose-built systems for the workflows off-the-shelf software can't handle — ERPs, CRMs, quoting engines, and operational platforms.

services.name: Data Analytics
services.description: Turning scattered operational data into dashboards and reports leadership actually uses to decide.

services.name: Digital Marketing
services.description: Measurable acquisition across search, social, and email — strategy, campaigns, and analytics tied to revenue, not vanity metrics.

services.name: Machine Learning Solutions
services.description: Predictive models for forecasting, classification, and anomaly detection — built pragmatically and only where they beat simpler methods.

services.name: Mobile App Development
services.description: Native-quality iOS and Android apps from a single codebase — designed for real usage patterns, offline conditions, and app-store approval.

services.name: SEO Services
services.description: Technical and content SEO that compounds — earning the searches your customers already make, month after month.

services.name: Web Development
services.description: Fast, secure, search-friendly websites and web applications — from corporate sites and e-commerce to complex customer portals.
